text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day has finally come for the Arima Kinen, the last big race of the senior year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature is no longer the timid girl she once was. Determined to shine brighter than anyone else…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She sets out for the Arima Kinen, where great runners await her—Tokai Teio among them.
